beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its medical situations keep the body present beside promises of continuation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its relationships also prevent a technical definition from deciding every obligation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reading gives these competing claims time to become more than positions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The investigation travels through archives, clinics, and public promises about distant worlds.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Each setting changes what continuity means to the people encountering it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Storage and infrastructure become part of questions that first sounded intimate.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The expanding geography never makes the household question irrelevant.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Instead, public ambition gives that question new costs and new audiences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its archives place stored lives beside the energy and permissions sustaining them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The journey makes intimate attachment answerable to obligations beyond a single family.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel does not let uncertainty remove the need to act.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its people must make choices before every philosophical question becomes answerable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That pressure is central to the reading experience it offers.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You can follow an investigation while reconsidering your standards for recognition.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The story suits readers drawn to intimate science fiction and difficult institutions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It rewards attention to who speaks, who consents, and who can refuse.
